metadata.description: Starter Pack for Businesses: Get a custom logo, brand kit, and social media templates for Rs. 75,000. Create a professional brand identity effortlessly!

content.rendered:
Starting a business is thrilling, but honestly, it can also be a little intimidating. Your brand isn’t just a logo or some colours; it’s the story your business tells the world. That’s why our Starter Pack for Businesses is designed to make branding easy, effective, and fun.

At Creativate, we’ve put together the Starter Branding Kit, your one-stop solution to create a professional and cohesive brand identity. Whether you’re launching a new venture or giving your current brand a fresh twist, this kit will make sure your business turns heads for all the right reasons.

What’s in the Box?

For just Rs. 75,000, here’s what you get:

  • Brand Kit: A personalised guide featuring your brand’s colours, typography, and style guidelines. Think of it as the DNA of your business identity.
  • Logo: Custom-designed by our team to reflect your brand’s story.
  • Email Signature: Professional and sleek, because every email deserves to make an impression.
  • Business Cards: Designed to wow at every handshake or networking event.
  • Letterheads: For official communications that look as sharp as your ideas.
  • Social Media Templates: Crafted by a team that’s vying for the title of best social media marketing agency, perfect for consistent, scroll-stopping posts.
  • Two Branded Notepads: Yes, actual, printed notepads with your logo, shipped right to your door.
  • Notepad Design: Customised for brainstorming brilliance.

And the best part? Everything is designed, packaged, and sent straight to your doorstep. No running around or back-and-forth headaches, just a professional brand identity at your fingertips.

Why Choose Our Starter Pack for Businesses?

Your brand is often the first impression customers get, and let’s be real, first impressions matter. A polished, cohesive visual identity sets the tone for how clients, partners, and competitors see you.

With the Starter Branding Kit, you’ll have everything you need to:

  • Look professional across all touchpoints, from emails to social media.
  • Save time by having all your branding essentials created by experts.
  • Feel confident knowing your visuals align with your business vision.

At Creativate, we combine creativity with strategy. We’re not just designing; we’re crafting tools to help you connect with your audience, make an impact, and stand out in the crowd.

Who’s This Kit For?

This Starter Pack for Businesses is perfect for:

  • Entrepreneurs: Whether you’re starting from scratch or rebranding, this kit has you covered.
  • Small Business Owners: Create a unified look for your business without breaking a sweat.
  • Freelancers: Step up your professional game and leave a lasting impression.
  • Established Brands: Need a refresh? This kit makes consistency effortless.

This starter kit is designed with you in mind. It’s professional, versatile, and ready to help you show your brand with clarity and confidence

Why Wait?

At Creativate, we focus on creating visual identities that represent the personality of your business. You won’t have to juggle design decisions, stress about deadlines, or wonder if your brand looks “right.” We’ve got it all covered.

With Rs. 75,000, you’ll have a fully branded package delivered to your door. A professional logo, branded social media templates, email signatures, business stationery, and more, all ready to make your business look professional from the very first interaction.

Book a free consultation with us today and let’s make branding the easiest part of building your business.

Here’s to creating a brand that speaks volumes, right from the start!
